function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the contents of a file. Returns numbered lines. Use offset and limit to paginate through large files.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed, default 1)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read (default 2000)

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write content to a file at the given path. Creates parent directories if needed.

path.description: The file path to write to

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Edit a file by replacing old_text with new_text. Supports minor whitespace/line-ending differences. Set replace_all=true to replace every occurrence.

old_text.description: The text to find and replace

function.name: list_dir
function.description: List the contents of a directory. Set recursive=true to explore nested structure. Common noise directories (.git, node_modules, __pycache__, etc.) are auto-ignored.

function.name: exec
function.description: Execute a shell command and return its output. Use with caution.

working_dir.description: Optional working directory for the command

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds. Increase for long-running commands like compilation or installation (default 300, max 600).

function.name: web_search
function.description: Search the web. Returns titles, URLs, and snippets.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Fetch URL and extract readable content (HTML → markdown/text).

function.name: message
function.description: Send a message to the user, optionally with file attachments. This is the ONLY way to deliver files (images, documents, audio, video) to the user. Use the 'media' parameter with file paths to attach files. Do NOT use read_file to send files — that only reads content for your own analysis.

media.description: Optional: list of file paths to attach (images, audio, documents)

function.name: spawn
function.description: Spawn a subagent to handle a task in the background. Use this for complex or time-consuming tasks that can run independently. The subagent will complete the task and report back when done. For deliverables or existing projects, inspect the workspace first and use a dedicated subdirectory when helpful.

task.description: The task for the subagent to complete

label.description: Optional short label for the task (for display)

function.name: sessions_yield
function.description: End the current model turn and wait for runtime events, primarily subagent completion events, to arrive as the next message. Use after spawning required background work when a final answer depends on it.
